diagnosis: The original proof repeatedly unpacks bisimilarity into its witness relation and then converts residual relation proofs back into bisimilarity. The existing `follow_fst` and `follow_snd` operations on bisimilarity already perform that conversion, allowing a shorter direct case analysis.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  use @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor
  · intro s1' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨s2', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨s2', htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
  · intro s2' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨s1', htr', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨s1', htr', ChoiceBisim.bisim h'⟩
